story.label: Our story
story.headline:
Every component.
Every line of code.
Ours.
story.body: Genesis Technology isn't an assembler or reseller. We fully design, develop, and manufacture professional beverage machines in Bulgaria — from the laser cutting and bending of metal chassis to the proprietary software that runs each system. Everything happens under one roof.
story.body2: In a market dominated by German, Italian, and Swiss manufacturers, Genesis is a rare independent that controls the entire vertical. That's not a talking point — it's the reason we can guarantee parts, customise hardware, and trace every component to the engineer who made it.

items.name: Genesis Universa
items.description: A modular system bridging ESE pods and fresh-brew in a single footprint. Designed for operators who need variety without complexity — configured to your menu, not the other way around.

items.name: Genesis Alpha
items.description: A bean-to-cup system engineered for high-volume hospitality. Dual boilers, precision grind calibration, AI-powered recipes, and a self-cleaning architecture that keeps the machine in service when it matters most.

items.name: Genesis Prime
items.description: A cloud-connected smart beverage system with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, built for chains and multi-site operators who need centralised control. Remote monitoring, error diagnostics, and OTA updates — your fleet managed from one dashboard.

items.name: Genesis Eclipse
items.description: A post-mix and cold beverage system built for environments where speed, consistency, and portion control are non-negotiable. Exact servings at exact temperatures, hundreds of times a day.

items.name: Genesis Solaris
items.description: A versatile compact machine with a large touchscreen and multilingual software. Custom recipe configuration, post-mix capability, and a footprint that fits anywhere — from counter-service cafés to petrol stations.

items.name: Genesis Solaris 2
items.description: The evolution of Solaris — same compact form, upgraded internals. Enhanced touch interface, faster brew cycles, improved energy efficiency, and full IoT connectivity for remote management.

steps.text: Tell us about your business — volume, space, drink preferences
Our team recommends the right machine configuration for your specific needs
Receive a detailed proposal with pricing, timeline, and customisation options
Our certified technicians install and calibrate your machine on-site
Staff training ensures your team can operate everything from day one
Configure drink recipes — adjust strengths, sweetness, milk ratios
Choose LED lighting colour to match your brand environment
Upload your logo and brand visuals to the machine's display
Monitor performance, consumption, and health via the cloud dashboard
Use the mobile app for drink selection, nutrition tracking, and management
Proactive alerts notify you of maintenance needs before they become issues
Remote diagnostics and on-site service — sub-4-hour response

features.title: Cloud Management
features.description: Monitor every machine in your fleet from one dashboard. Real-time consumption data, error diagnostics, recipe management — accessible from anywhere.

features.title: AI Operating System
features.description: Patent-registered intelligent system that learns your business patterns. The machine adapts to peak hours, suggests optimisations, and flags maintenance before you notice a problem.

features.title: Mobile Application
features.description: Contactless drink selection via personal devices. Nutrition tracking, allergen alerts, ingredient control. All without touching the machine screen.

features.title: Over-the-Air Updates
features.description: New drinks, new recipes, software improvements — pushed wirelessly. Your machine gets better while you sleep.
